(2) Notwithstanding the repeal of section 8 of Part II of
the Finance Act, No. 38 of 1971, any budget prepared by
any public corporation in terms of the provisions of repealed
section 8 of Part II of the Finance Act, No. 38 of 1971 and
subsisting  on  the  day  immediately  preceding  the  date  of
coming into operation of this Act, shall be deemed to be a
budget prepared under section 59 of this Act.
